title: Methods on named types
hints: Methods can be declared on any named type you define, including ones based on float64 or a slice. fmt prints a value using its String() string method when it has one.

Give String a value receiver: fmt.Sprint(c) passes a Celsius value, and a method with a pointer receiver isn't in the method set of a plain value, so fmt wouldn't find it. %.1f formats one decimal place.
func (c Celsius) Fahrenheit() float64 { return float64(c)*9/5 + 32 }; func (c Celsius) String() string { return fmt.Sprintf("%.1f°C", float64(c)) }; Warmest: like MinMax from earlier, over the slice.
